limitations: Valid for nonzero finite square-zero radical factors over fields of characteristic not two, with normalized operators. No classification of general augmented algebras or of smaller braided subcategories is claimed. Earlier implicit coverage is possible.
scientific_integrity: The oriented monoidal product, necessary rank condition and extreme-ratio symmetric families are explicitly credited to Guo–Xie–Zhang; the new result is the exact order-isomorphism criterion and intermediate-ratio counterexample family.
title: Exact tensor-order isomorphism criterion for square-zero augmented Rota–Baxter factors
